text.p: HealthCare COMPARE Corp said it expects 1997 earnings to be about $2.62 to $2.63 a share in 1997, up from $2.24 in 1996.

"Our (earnings per share) growth will bring us to around $2.62-$2.63 this year," Joseph Whitters, chief financial officer, told a Piper Jaffray investment conference here Wednesday. "We're comfortable in that area."
He added that earnings are expected to be about $0.64 a share in the second quarter, $0.67 in the third quarter and $0.70 in the fourth quarter, compared with $0.61 earned in the first quarter.
For 1998, Whitters said he was "comfortable" with analysts' estimates around $3.10 a share, with about $0.05 coming from First Health Strategies, which HealthCare is acquiring from First Data Corp.
"Once the (First Health) deal closes in early July, we'll be on a run rate to see something in the neighborhood of $550 million or so (in revenues) in 1998," Whitters said.
He added he was comfortable with analysts' estimates for 1997 revenues around "$280 million-plus," excluding First Health Services.
First Health Services is not expected to add to 1997 earnings, Whitters said.
